newsitem.title: USA: Apache completes drilling on Alberta well.
newsitem.headline: Apache completes drilling on Alberta well.

text.p: Apache Corp said that it has completed drilling on a horizontal natural gas find in Alberta that reached a vertical depth of 8,430 feet, a record for a horizontal well drilling with coiled tubing.

Apache said that it penetrated a combined 1,200 feet of horizontal pay in the Elkton formation. Flow rates of between 5.2 million cubic feet and 6.4 million cubic feet of gas per day were recorded during drilling, in the Harmattan field.
Apache owns a 69 percent working interest in the well, which is expected to be connected to pipeline in March. Apache plans to drill four more wells in the Harmattan field in 1997.
